hooks.text: A cosmic abyss two billion light-years wide is stealing light's energy.
A region nearly two billion light-years wide is missing almost everything.
The largest structure in our universe is made of absolutely nothing.

title: The Billion Light-Year Hole Draining Space's Energy
description: Astronomers discovered the Eridanus Supervoid, a gargantuan chasm nearly two billion light-years wide that actively chills light from the early universe.

beats.text: A cosmic abyss two billion light-years wide is stealing light's energy.
beats.visual: 3D computer rendering of the cosmic web showing a giant empty void, 2021

beats.text: Spanning nearly two billion light-years across, the Eridanus Supervoid holds the record as space's most massive emptiness.
beats.visual: Celestial chart showing the constellation Eridanus in deep space, 2020

beats.text: Inside this gargantuan cosmic chasm, vast amounts of galaxies, gas, and dark matter are missing.
beats.visual: Deep space astronomical survey showing vast regions devoid of galaxies, 2021

beats.text: As light from the Big Bang enters the void, dark energy accelerates space's expansion.
beats.visual: Diagram of cosmic expansion and photon energy loss crossing a void, 2015

beats.text: The stretched gravitational landscape drains energy from passing photons, cooling them as they exit.
beats.visual: All-sky cosmic microwave background radiation map captured by the Planck satellite, 2013

beats.text: This leaves a region significantly colder than the universe's background radiation, encircled by a warm ring.
beats.visual: Close-up image of the CMB Cold Spot in Eridanus taken by Planck, 2013
queries: CMB Cold Spot Planck detailed view

beats.text: But standard math shows this void only explains a fraction of the cold.
beats.visual: Photograph of the Victor M. Blanco Telescope dome at Cerro Tololo, 2021
queries: Victor M Blanco Telescope Cerro Tololo
Dark Energy Survey Blanco telescope dome

beats.text: Current physics cannot explain why this void drains cosmic energy so aggressively.
beats.visual: Full all-sky view of the early universe microwave radiation background, 2013
queries: ESA Planck CMB background full sky
